notes.title: New Level Army of the Dead and two new locomotives!
notes.content:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

[list]
[*] You can now play a brand new level called Army of the Dead! Watch out for those Tank driving zombie bosses!
[*] Brand new weapon, the missile launcher! A rapid fire, high velocity, low damage, excellent knock back missile that is highly effective at clearing a path.
[*] Two new locomotives have been added to the game, the German DRG Class 05 Steam locomotive equipped with Missile Launcher, Tommy gun and Shot gun, and the American GP38 equipped with Missile Launcher, Grenade Launcher and Minigun.
[*] For every thirty levels gained you now receive the option to select one of three random relics as a reward.
[*] A second mysterious container has been added at the 75% journey mark. This container spawns two special bosses for extra fun and tons of resource rewards.
[*] Fix - When the train gets a speed debuff the max speed of the train is dropped to half and this will lower the cruise control target speed if it is greater than max speed. Now when the debuff wears off the cruise control target speed will be restored to the previously set target speed like you'd expect it to!
[*] Drone damage is now shown on the Game Over screen.
[*] All those left over upgrade pallets when you win a stage are now beneficial. For every pallet left over you get 50 gold! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/be7de4e9dbbd4dcd81adf980c9fee18a24eece9d.png[/img]

Thanks,
GTGD

notes.title: Making awesome progress on the new Level: Army of the Dead!
notes.content:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers,

notes.title: Choo Choo Relics are here. A new realm of becoming OP!
notes.content:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

Here is the Choo Choo Relics update I’ve been talking about and it adds a fun optional random element to the gameplay. With the power of relics on your side beating Hard Mode is much more possible and with a lucky combination of relics you can become seriously OP! Relics are collected from abandoned warehouses that you’ll see as you drive through the stage and their effect only lasts for that stage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/86abe6b63ca1c943cb9143d1edf6228666fb8300.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/7c431130c557c2d36edd749b71c36a16770edfc4.png[/img]

If you click on the abandoned warehouse you'll be presented with a random scenario such as:
[list]
[*] You find X amount of gold but it will cost you Y amount of your diesel to take it.
[*] You find X amount of upgrade points but it will cost you Y amount of your diesel to take it.
[*] You find a Relic but you'll have to buy it from a mutant survivor for X amount gold.
[*] You find a Relic amongst a strong group of zombies and they'll attack you if you take it.
[/list]
There are currently 20 relics and their effects stack which is pretty neat. All relics have a positive effect and many are combined with a lesser negative effect as well. I’ve added 21 more Steam achievements to the game.

For details on the relics and their effect check out the Steam achievements for the game and you'll see what each relic does. Also when collecting them you can of course see their effect in game as well.

I hope you all enjoy this content update and in the coming weeks I’ll have more to share on future content updates.

Keep on going Choo Choo Engineers and let me know what your favourite relics are!

notes.title: Bunker second weapon infinite money bug and other patches
notes.content:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers, this is a bug fix and slight improvements patch!

Fixed a bug where the bunker second weapon could be refunded over and over making easy money. The downside is everyone must buy it again if it had been bought. The upside is that everyone who had unlocked it will receive 20,000 gold in compensation when they start the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/7019b2e748c3f1d59c9c635898f32f1ac00e1390.png[/img]

In the main menu when selecting a locomotive the starting weapon on that locomotive is now the first one shown in the row.

Fixed a bug where if you didn't press the bunker button to advance time to 35 minutes, and you exceeded 31 minutes, you could press the button to go back to 31 minutes.

Once you have purchased the permanent EXP magnet and accomplished the Attracted To Learning achievement, exp magnet pallets will stop showing as a pickup and are no longer required. The spawn rate of all pallet types are independent of one another and don't affect each other.

Keep on winning Choo Choo Engineers!

notes.title: Special gun upgrades, explosive, stunning and poison bullets
notes.content:
You can now unlock an upgraded bullet for the machine gun, tommy gun, and shotgun. Unlock these from your Unlock Ability menu in the Main Menu.

[list]
[*] The machine gun can be upgraded to have explosive bullets that have up to 20% chance of exploding. 
[*] Tommy gun can be upgraded to have stun bullets that have up to 10% chance of immobilising a zombie for 5 seconds.
[*] Shotgun can be upgraded to have poison bullets that have up to 10% chance of reducing 20% of a zombies health every second over 5 seconds (super against bosses).
[/list]

When a zombie is stunned or poisoned you'll see the stunned or poisoned symbol on them.

With these changes I think you'll find that guns no longer feel like they are weaker than the bazooka and grenade launcher and now have their own unique aspect in helping you demolish the zombie horde.

notes.title: Guns visible on train, buying supplies before heading out, and a better crusher
notes.content:
A number of players asked to see the weapons firing on the locomotive, so I've added that. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/85c1bcb280855067d71fb89a1e5aa256e802d351.png[/img]

I've added the option for you to buy additional supplies before starting a level. Each additional supply costs $500. You can purchase a maximum of 20 upgrade pallets or whatever number you have enough money for less than 20. You are only billed when you select a level. When the level starts you'll find that you have the additional purchased upgrade pallets plus whatever you've unlocked through the ability unlock menu. I think this is important for being able to conquer Hard Mode. You're a train so of course you should be able to take some supplies with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/e104a59d85918072c25b7986b07c563858bd452c.png[/img]

The crusher has been improved so that it not only hurts the enemies but now reduces the slowdown caused by zombies. With a fully upgraded crusher you can really feel the power of the locomotive as it wades through the zombie horde crushing them beneath its mighty wheels.

From here on I'll be moving to a fortnightly or monthly schedule for significant game content updates. I'll still be doing smaller patches in between for bug fixes and tweaks to the game.

notes.title: Cruise Control - Now you can cruise through the zombie apocalypse
notes.content:
You can turn on cruise control by pressing the C key (which can be remapped). Accelerate forward or in reverse to the desired speed and press the C key. The locomotive will now try to maintain this speed until you press the C key again to deactivate Cruise Control. 

While driving in Cruise Control you can slow down the locomotive to pickup survivors by pressing the opposite direction key and this will decelerate the locomotive. When you let go off the key Cruise Control will take over and increase the locomotive speed back to the target speed.

[h2]Example:[/h2]
I've accelerated my locomotive to 4.3 m/s by pressing the left mouse button. I then press the C key to have the locomotive maintain this speed. I can let go off the left mouse button and the locomotive will maintain speed. Zombie hordes will slow down the locomotive but once they are defeated the locomotive will accelerate back to 4.3 m/s. If I'm passing a survivor I can slow the locomotive without breaking cruise by pressing the right mouse button. This will slow down the locomotive. Once the survivor is onboard I let go off the right mouse button and the locomotive will accelerate back to 4.3 m/s.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/c8d80dcbf4e5acb3b09e3e96e999f2297f5e2b0a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/cde28466457b17677a84a0ed506ee1f7514398c4.png[/img]

Time to cruise to victory Choo Choo Engineers!

notes.title: Separating zombie howling volume, clearer loco health and fuel, and fixing bugs
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone sending feedback and bug reports. 

[list]
[*] I moved the speedo, health, and diesel bars to the top right of the screen and made them bigger. You can now see them more easily (especially with the boss swarm) and you can see your health and fuel stats when the upgrade menu is open (in case you're thinking of buying health or fuel from there).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/2840c8f9a5684398ca4434a1decd8643096e109a.png[/img]
[*] I've separated the zombie howling sound from other FX sound. You can now turn off the zombie howling sounds if you find them annoying and still keep the other FX sounds playing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/a3a3edd8c988f0f8b578d8bd32728112e1b6b04d.png[/img]
[*] I think I've fixed the Steam overlay and unpausing exploit.
[*] Fixed diesel amount being able to go into negative numbers.
[*] When in the Main Menu screen you can now press the Escape key to quickly close any menu.
[*] I've changed the colour of all boss health sliders so they look different from the players health slider.
[*] A word of thanks to BlueBerry who has kindly volunteered to translate Choo Choo Survivor to Russian. Thank you! In a future update there should be Russian translation in game. The Steam store page has Russian translation now.
[/list]

notes.title: Now you can play Hard Mode!
notes.content:
I've added a new difficulty option to the game and you can choose to play Hard Mode. Winning hard mode on each level will earn you a steam achievement and later I'll be attaching a special ability that you can unlock by beating stages on Hard Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/282baef117cdcef03dd9e1dd44105e661e21ac19.png[/img]

So what is Hard Mode?
[list]
[*] All zombies have double health and do double damage.
[*] Bosses spawn in double quantity.
[*] Bosses only have a 25% chance of dropping a special reward
[*] Regular zombies spawn as larger packs with each spawn wave.
[*] Hard Mode is written at the top of the screen because you are awesome!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/e2abafad55c2329303206d995fdb9852e17ae46e.png[/img]

Good luck Choo Choo Engineers!

notes.title: Chat GPT’s story VS the Dev story for Choo Choo Survivor
notes.content:
Some people have been asking for more story for Choo Choo Survivor. As a solo indie dev my time is scarce so I’ve chosen to allocate my time towards making the game mechanics more fun and developing better meta progression. Therefore I outsourced the story matter to GhatGPT and you can compare its story vs my story below.

[h1]Chat GPT’s Choo Choo Survivor story[/h1]
In the desolate world of Choo Choo Survivor, an unimaginable catastrophe has befallen humanity. A lethal virus outbreak has turned people into ravenous zombies, leaving only a handful of survivors scattered across the remnants of civilization. Amidst the chaos, a brave train conductor named Alex emerges as a beacon of hope.

Alex finds himself in control of the last functional train, a relic from a bygone era. Determined to save as many survivors as possible, he embarks on a perilous journey to guide the train to safety. The mission is clear: steer the train through treacherous terrain and endless hordes of undead, seeking refuge in a distant sanctuary.

As Alex drives the train forward, he witnesses the grim reality of the world around him. Crumbling cities, overgrown forests, and desolate wastelands serve as haunting reminders of the once vibrant life that thrived. The tracks stretch out endlessly before him, fraught with obstacles and dangers at every turn.

Accompanying Alex are a courageous group of survivors, each with their own unique skills and stories. Together, they form a makeshift family, united by a shared will to survive. As the train hurtles forward, they must work together, defending against relentless zombie attacks and ensuring the safety of their fellow passengers.

With each passing day, the zombie hordes grow larger and more ferocious. Their hunger for human flesh is insatiable, and they relentlessly pursue the train, clawing and gnashing at its metallic shell. Alex and the survivors must utilize their limited resources wisely, scavenging for supplies and making difficult decisions to sustain their journey.

Along the way, they encounter remnants of a crumbling society—shattered remnants of hope and despair. Survivors in need of aid, abandoned shelters, and cryptic messages all contribute to the mystery surrounding the origins of the outbreak. Alex and his comrades strive to uncover the truth, believing that knowledge holds the key to humanity's salvation.

As they press on, the train becomes a fortress on wheels, retrofitted with defensive measures to repel the undead. Makeshift barricades, reinforced plating, and ingenious contraptions provide temporary respite in the face of relentless attacks. Yet, the battle for survival intensifies with each passing mile.

Through unwavering determination and sacrifice, Alex and his companions navigate through a nightmarish landscape, inching closer to their destination. The train's whistle pierces the desolate silence, echoing a call of resilience and defiance. They are survivors, a flickering flame in a world consumed by darkness.


[h1]Devs Choo Choo Survivor story[/h1]
Zombies are everywhere.
A locomotive seems like a great idea to get from A to B.
Ok lets drive the loco.
Ok there are too many zombies. Bring out the guns.
BOOM BOOM. BANG BANG.
Train gets to safety.
Hooray.
That was actually fun. Let’s do it again!

notes.title: Some more difficulty balancing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Yesterday I updated the game so that zombies would at first come slower towards the player and it would take 10 minutes to get to full movement speed. I've now increased that to 15 minutes. 
[*] I've also increased the max area of effect for weapons from 1.6m to 2.0m and each upgrade purchase increments by 0.4m instead of 0.2m. This makes increasing area of effect very valuable and also the starting area of effect is 0.4m instead of 0.2m radius. This makes early hit detection more accurate as well.
[*] I've also increased the locomotive to pallet distance threshold by 33% so that they don't have to get as near the locomotive for being captured.
[*] All of these changes make the game fairer on the player and Choo Choo Survivor is a game where you are supposed to be able to win and the more abilities you unlock the faster you should be able to complete the level. There will be Steam achievements for this.
[/list]
